local self = require('openmw.self')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local frames = 0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1
 if frames==5 then
  local equipment=types.Actor.getEquipment(self)
  local skills=types.NPC.stats.skills
  print('M15 advanced unarmed ready: block=' .. tostring(skills.block(self).base) .. ' hand=' .. tostring(skills.handtohand(self).base) .. ' right=' .. tostring(equipment[types.Actor.EQUIPMENT_SLOT.CarriedRight]~=nil) .. ' left=' .. tostring(equipment[types.Actor.EQUIPMENT_SLOT.CarriedLeft]~=nil))
 end
end}}}}
